evidence.title: GitHub - realvjy/coolshapes-react: 100+ abstract shapes with gradient for design & dev project

name: CoolShapes
summary: Open-source set of 100+ abstract shapes with grainy gradients, as SVG, PNG, a Figma file and a React package.
description: CoolShapes is a set of 100+ abstract shapes with grainy gradients for design and dev projects: download or copy them as SVG or PNG, grab the Figma file, or install the coolshapes-react package and render shapes with type, index, noise and size props. MIT licensed, free for personal and commercial use.
